qualifier_findings.explanation: The candidate claim states that the NVIDIA 10-Q 2027 Q2 risk factors section clearly states there are no material changes compared to the risk factors described in the Annual Report for fiscal year ended January 25, 2026 and the Quarterly Report for the quarter ended April 26, 2026. The evidence text from page 34 states: 'Other than the risk factors listed below, there have been no material changes from the risk factors previously described under Item 1A of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 25, 2026 and Item 1A of our Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended April 26, 2026.' This means the report explicitly excludes some risk factors listed below from the 'no material changes' statement. Therefore, the candidate's summary omits the exception 'Other than the risk factors listed below,' which is a material qualifier. The candidate's claim that it 'clearly states there are no material changes' is unsupported because it omits this important qualifier.
